prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up shot of a person holding a tablet, browsing an online clothing store. The screen displays a model wearing a striking, patterned blouse with wide, elbow-length sleeves. The blouse features a bold black background adorned with large, white floral motifs, and a prominent, intricately textured white lace panel at the chest. The model’s face is cropped out, focusing attention on the garment and the model’s confident pose, with hands resting on hips. The tablet interface shows size options listed vertically on the left side (XXL, XL, L, M, S), with the user’s finger poised to select a size. The lighting is soft and natural, creating a gentle, realistic ambiance with minimal shadows. The color palette is neutral and understated, dominated by the monochrome tones of the blouse and the clean white background of the product photo. The composition is intimate and documentary in style, with a shallow depth of field that keeps the tablet screen in sharp focus while subtly blurring the hand and background, evoking a sense of personal engagement and modern digital shopping.
